source='''def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c, value) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]
    candidates = []
    for orientation in (0, 1):  # c-r diagonal, then r+c diagonal
        coord = (lambda r, c: c-r) if orientation == 0 else (lambda r, c: r+c)
        for period in range(1, max(n, m) + 1):
            phases = {}
            valid = True
            for r, c, value in points:
                phase = coord(r, c) % period
                if phase in phases and phases[phase] != value:
                    valid = False
                    break
                phases[phase] = value
            if valid:
                candidates.append((period, orientation, phases))
                break
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("No consistent diagonal period found")
    period, orientation, phases = min(candidates, key=lambda item: item[0])
    coord = (lambda r, c: c-r) if orientation == 0 else (lambda r, c: r+c)
    return [[phases[coord(r, c) % period] for c in range(m)] for r in range(n)]
'''
